_note: Review of every game method patched by two or more owners (archmap rule R5). Hand-written; archmap --check fails when a shared target or a new owner on one is missing here, when an entry is stale, or when an ORDER-SENSITIVE pair is not declared in code. classification: INDEPENDENT (the relative order of our patches cannot change the outcome) or ORDER-SENSITIVE (it can). order: [earlier, later] module ids; the later module's patch on the target carries [HarmonyAfter("com.marci.boscalisummer.module.<earlier>")] (or the earlier one [HarmonyBefore(...)] naming the later). HarmonyX runs every prefix even after one returned false, so a skipping prefix does not shield later prefixes; prefixes always run before postfixes, so only patches of the same kind can be order-sensitive.

AeroPart.AeroPart_OnInitialize.reason: Both prefixes act only on parts of their own aircraft (Megaplane.Is vs the Skylark jsonKey): disjoint instances.

Aircraft.FilterInputs.reason: Two skip predicates (Megaplane aircraft, Skywell-steered receiver) that read no state the other writes; Progression's is the only postfix.

Aircraft.StartEjectionSequence.reason: Both prefixes may skip with their own side effects (Wing's block counter, the ace's rebirth); every prefix runs and neither reads what the other writes.

Aircraft.UseFuel.reason: Ares' AresFuelPatch writes ref fuelDrawn = 0; Skylark's SkylarkBatteryFuelPatch reads fuelDrawn to decide whether a silent Skylark skips the draw.

AircraftActionsReport.ReportText.reason: One prefix (Chatter takes the notice) and one postfix (Hud reads the box); prefixes always run before postfixes.

Building.OnStartClient.reason: Postfixes on disjoint buildings: Trenches strips its own positions' dugout, UrbanCombat dresses garrison/rooftop names.

Building.OnStartServer.reason: Postfixes: Trenches hides its own positions' dugout; Vanguard only records the building's position for SA-74.

Bullet.TrajectoryTrace.reason: Read-only prefixes capture state into __state; the postfixes submit to separate managers (impact fires, near-miss crack).

CameraCockpitState.UpdateState.reason: Both postfixes multiply cam.transform.localRotation (quaternions do not commute). Hud's SimSpinPatch is dev-only and patched by hand under its own Harmony id when a sim starts, so it ran after Immersion; its HarmonyMethod now says so.

CombatAI.ChooseHQTarget.reason: Wing's WingTargetPatch (filtered station list, Veto) and WingSquad.AceTargetPatch and Spooktober's FallenAceTargetPatch all rewrite __result; they serve different searchers today, but the ace's choice stays last.

CommandLineArgParser.LoadMission.reason: Three prefixes each resolve a name and write __result; all run, so the last one that resolves wins (Maps over Gamemodes over Scenario).

DetectorManager.RequestLoSCheck.reason: Two pure skip predicates (smoke, trench works); the original is skipped if either says so.

DynamicMap.MapControls.reason: Wing's WmcMapControlsPatch applies a pending CENTER/FIT to the view; Command's MapControlsPanelGuardPatch then reads the cursor's map position (TryGetCursorCoordinates). Comms' prefix is a pure predicate.

Encyclopedia.AfterLoad.reason: Each postfix appends definitions to Encyclopedia.IndexLookup, whose order is the network index every peer must agree on (SeaStructures' also runs before Blueprinter).

FactionHQ.RpcUpdateTrackingInfo.reason: Three skip gates (link discipline, peace, CYBER relay hold) reading their own scopes; CombatAdjust's stat counters run whatever the others return.

Factory.ProduceUnit.reason: Two pure skip predicates (competitive gamemode, nation-managed factory).

Gun.Fire.reason: Skip prefixes on disjoint guns (Megaplane battery turrets, Skylark Halberd, Vanguard LANCE); their side effects touch only their own state.

HUDUnitMarker.UpdateColor.reason: Hud's MarkerColorPatch captures the colour Wing's WingHudTint.UpdateColorPatch writes; Priority.Last already put it last (kept, it also orders it after other plugins).

Hangar.CanSpawnAircraft.reason: Both prefixes append their aircraft to the hangar's availableAircraft array; the order fixes the list order where a hangar offers both.

Hangar.GetAvailableAircraft.reason: Same patch classes as Hangar.CanSpawnAircraft: both append to availableAircraft.

Hangar.SpawnAircraft.reason: Megaplane's MegaplaneHangarAirStartPatch reads __runOriginal, so Gamemodes' HeavyweightQueuedSpawnPatch refusal must come first or the air start spawns a refused aircraft.

MapBuilding.Destruct.reason: Postfixes into separate state: the ruin, scar and collapse (FireAndDestruction) and the garrison nest kill (UrbanCombat).

MapBuilding.TakeShockwave.reason: One postfix (hit ledger) and one prefix (records blast power); different kinds.

MapLoader.Load.reason: Gamemodes clears the loaded-map keys and Maps adds catalogue entries in separate prefixes. Megaplane's client-only postfix waits for its aircraft definition after native loading.

MessageFeed.Enqueue.reason: Read-only postfixes into separate ledgers (TacticalLog, EventFeed).

MessageManager.UserCode_RpcKillMessage_*.reason: Command's TacticalLogKillPatch opens a scope that tags the next MessageFeed line with the kill; Chatter's and Wing's prefixes (radio, kill credit and awards) can post lines and run before it. Nation's prefix only books war support.

Missile.DetectCollisions.reason: One transpiler (water velocity guard) and one prefix (torpedo/HAMILCAR); different kinds.

Missile.Detonate.reason: Prefixes on disjoint missiles (Support rods, Vanguard SA-74); neither changes arguments.

Missile.SetAimpoint.reason: Each prefix adds an offset to ref aimPoint that it computes without reading aimPoint; vector addition commutes.

Missile.StartMissile.reason: Postfixes that attach separate rigs and book entries.

Missile.UserCode_RpcDetonate_897349600.reason: Support's SupportMissileDetonatePatch sets ref armed = false for its rods, EMPs and flares; FireAndDestruction's MissileImpactPatch reads armed and so still sees them armed. Vanguard's SA-74 skip touches neither.

Mission.OnSceneLoaded.reason: Core's mission-profile prefix and Gamemodes' postfix; different kinds.

MissionManager.SetMission.reason: Core's mission-profile prefix and Pmc's postfix; different kinds.

MissionPosition.TryGetClosestPosition.reason: Both postfixes write destination/__result, but for disjoint unit types (AirSurvival: Aircraft; TheaterOps: GroundVehicle).

MountedCargo.Fire.reason: Gamemodes' prefix is a pure skip; Vanguard's Skywell toggle reads nothing Gamemodes writes.

MountedTroops.Fire.reason: One prefix (pure skip) and one postfix (air assault deploy); different kinds.

NetworkManagerNuclearOption.RegisterPref.reason: Postfixes registering different prefabs with the ClientObjectManager, keyed by prefab hash, not by order.

Pilot.ApplyDamage.reason: Wing's WingPilotFatalDamagePatch rewrites the ref damage arguments and both Wing prefixes read them to judge lethality; Spooktober's FallenAcePilotDamagePatch rewrites them for the ace. Squad's prefix reads only `dead`.

PilotPlayerState.FixedUpdateState.reason: When the pilot is flying a drone, Vanguard writes the unattended aircraft's hold inputs after the landing autopilot.

PilotDismounted.Capture.reason: Observers: prefix/postfix pairs recording a rescue into separate state.

Radar.CanSeeRadarReturn.reason: Both prefixes only ever write __result = false and skip; the same value whoever writes last.

TargetDetector.DetectTarget.reason: CombatAdjust and Support open scopes on their own thread-statics and restore them in their own finalizers; Pmc and Vanguard are pure skip predicates.

Turret.FixedUpdate.reason: One prefix (sleeping-turret skip) and one postfix (ALE-X lock delay); different kinds.

Unit.RecordDamage.reason: Postfixes recording the damager into separate state.

Unit.ReportKilled.reason: Squad and Support record kills in separate state in postfixes. Megaplane's opt-in development prefix only increments the Groza crew test witness count.

UnitDefinition.IsAllowed.reason: Both postfixes only turn __result from true to false; the conjunction does not depend on order.

UnitMapIcon.ClickIcon.reason: Both prefixes handle the same click with side effects (Wing's WmcMapSelection.ClickIconPatch selects for WMC, Command's MapBoxIconClickGuardPatch drives the map's selection) and both always run.

UnitMapIcon.UpdateIcon.reason: Wing's WingMapTint.MapIconColorPatch badges the icon from its current scale; Command's MfdReliefUnitIconPatch then rescales (MapSymbology.Fit) and moves it (ProjectIcon).

UnitPart.TakeDamage.reason: Spooktober's FallenAcePartDamagePatch rewrites the ref damage (ace lives, gunnery perk) and Ares' AresPartDamagePatch multiplies it for ONE-HIT KILLS. Gamemodes' and Kaiju's prefixes are pure skips.

WeaponStation.LaunchMount.reason: Megaplane's rotating silo dispatch respects Support's CYBER launch gate before firing. Vanguard handles different weapons.
